channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Les Grands Montets: 74 cm of New Snow in 72 Hours
item.description: Les Grands Montets saw 74 cm of new snow in the last 72 hours, with more forecast for the coming days, according to our model on November 17, 2026.

item.title: Austria is behind: Kühtai has 20 cm, a normal 17 November has 33 cm
item.description: Austria is behind: Kühtai has 20 cm, a normal 17 November has 33 cm. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Austria on 17 November.

item.title: Finland or Sweden? Where the snow is better on 17 November
item.description: Finland or Sweden? Where the snow is better on 17 November. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Finland on 17 November.

item.title: Snow is coming in France: up to 87 cm in the week ahead
item.description: Snow is coming in France: up to 87 cm in the week ahead. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in France on 17 November.

item.title: Italy loses 8,670 km² of snow in one day as mild weather brings thaw
item.description: Rapid snow loss across Italy on 17 November as temperatures rise. Only 12,540 km² remains covered, down from 21,210 km² yesterday. The Aosta Valley saw 134 cm of new snow in 72 hours.

item.title: Norway braced for major snow: 39 cm expected in the week ahead
item.description: Norway's snow cover is growing fast. Up to 39 cm of new snow is forecast over the next seven days, with the heaviest fall on November 20.

item.title: Polish snow cover down 590 km² in seven days: Karpacz leads
item.description: Poland's snow-covered area shrank from 1,300 to 710 km² in a week. Karpacz holds the deepest snow at 36 cm as of 17 November.

item.title: Slovakia: snow line at 1,200 m as early-season cover melts back
item.description: Slovakia's snow cover dropped to 1,830 km2 today. Snow sits mostly above 1,200 m; the High Tatras and Low Tatras lead with 8 cm of new snow in 72 hours.

item.title: 59 Swedish ski resorts now have snow cover across their terrain
item.description: 79% of Sweden's ski areas show snow today. Upper slopes at Björkliden and Abisko carry 131 cm. The Hemavan fjells led the past 72 hours with 15 cm of fresh snow.

item.title: Alpine snow distribution after the storm: Valais Alps lead with 92 cm in 72 hours
item.description: Fresh snow fell unevenly across Swiss mountains. The Valais Alps received 92 cm in three days; the Bernese Oberland 54 cm. Data from 17 November.

item.title: UK snow cover surged 6,810 km² in seven days
item.description: UK gained 8,380 km² of snow cover by 17 November. The North Pennines led with 27 cm in 72 hours.

item.title: Ukraine 6% white, Poland 11%: Carpathian snow divide widening
item.description: Ukraine's snow cover dropped to 6% today as the Carpathians melt back. Poland holds twice the white share. Both countries face fresh snow by Friday.

item.title: 22 Czech resorts have snow above 1000 m: where the white patches are
item.description: Only 22 of 170 Czech ski areas show snow cover on 17 November. The Jeseníky and Krkonoše lead with 9 cm and 8 cm in 72 hours. More snow arrives from 20 November.

item.title: Slovenia 6 % snow cover, Austria triple at 34 %: the Alpine divide
item.description: Slovenia has only 6 % white cover today against Austria's 34 %. Fresh snow in the Julian Alps offers the best chance for early season runs. Data from 17 November.

item.title: The snow is shrinking in Germany: 840 km² gone since last week
item.description: The snow is shrinking in Germany: 840 km² gone since last week. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Germany on 17 November.

item.title: Orelle tracks the normal 42 cm path as November snow arrives
item.description: Orelle holds 42 cm, close to the typical 53 cm for mid-November. Fresh snow forecast across the Alps over the next three days.

item.title: Les Arcs 96 cm incoming; snowy three days ahead
item.description: 96 cm of new snow forecast for Les Arcs over the next three days, with today bringing the heaviest falls; model run November 16.

item.title: US West snow outlook to 30 November: 54 in at Kingvale, 53 in at Mt. Shasta Ski Park
item.description: The two-week picture in the US West, 17 November to 30 November, drawn from the two global models that reach two weeks, ECMWF and GFS. Middle of the …

item.title: Western Canada: Where did 76 cm of fresh snow fall?
item.description: Whistler Blackcomb saw 76 cm of new snow in the last 72 hours, with Mount Cain Alpine Park also receiving 64 cm, as of November 16, 2026.

item.title: Andorra 2 %, France 11 %: snow divide on the ridge
item.description: On 16 November, Andorra has snow cover on just 2 % of its area while France climbs to 11 %; the gap reflects autumn patterns, with deeper falls forecast next week.

item.title: How many Austrian resorts have snow cover? 215 of 277
item.description: 215 of 277 Austrian ski resorts have early-season snow on 16 November. The snow line sits at 1500 metres; expect 50 cm in the next week.

item.title: Borovets 5 cm: Bulgaria at 2% coverage, Romania at 10%
item.description: Bulgaria covers just 2% in white with 5 cm at Borovets on its first snow day, while Romania shows 10%, measured 2026-11-16

item.title: Croatia loses half its snow cover in one day as thaw reaches 1,500 m
item.description: Mild conditions erased 950 km2 of snow across Croatia on 16 November. Only 880 km2 remains, mostly above 1,500 m. Next snow arrives 21 November.

item.title: Mild spell melts 530 km² across Czechia in 24 hours
item.description: Thaw has shrunk Czechia's snow cover from 1,250 km² to 720 km² in one day. Measured 16 November. Fresh snow arrives 17 November.

item.title: Finland's snow storage swelled 138,530 km² in one week
item.description: Finland gained 138,530 km² of snow cover in a week, reaching 157,360 km² as the season opened. Data from 16 November 2026.

item.title: France or Switzerland? Where the snow is better on 16 November
item.description: France or Switzerland? Where the snow is better on 16 November. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in France on 16 November.

item.title: Germany snow at 43% of normal for mid-November
item.description: German Alps show just 43% of normal snow depth across tracked resorts on 16 November, well behind schedule as the season opens.

item.title: Monterosa Ski leads Italy at 138% of normal snow
item.description: Monterosa Ski holds 99 cm, 38% above normal for mid-November, as Italian Alps gain early snow on 16 November.

item.title: 76 cm at Jotunheimen: where Norway's fresh snow fell
item.description: Fresh snow from a three-day storm peaked at 76 cm in Jotunheimen and 74 cm in Hardangervidda, Norway's high ranges, on 16 November.

item.title: Poland loses 910 km² of snow cover in one mild day
item.description: Rapid thaw removed nearly 44% of Poland's snow cover on 16 November. Only 1,170 km² remains white, with recovery expected from 17 November.

item.title: Romania loses 6,270 km² of snow in a week: peaks hold steady
item.description: Snow coverage in Romania dropped from 12,900 km² to 6,630 km² in a week, but peaks above 1,500 m keep their white cover as of 16 November.

item.title: Riksgränsen 173 cm leads Scandinavia by commanding margin
item.description: Riksgränsen dominates Scandinavia with 173 cm of snow depth measured on 16 November, holding far more mountain water than any rival resort in the region.

item.title: 3 of 9 Serbian resorts have snow: Avantura park leads
item.description: Three of Serbia's nine resorts hold measurable snow on 16 November. Avantura park tops the ranking with 28 cm depth at its station.

item.title: Slovakia gains 1,430 km² of snow cover in one week
item.description: Slovakia's snow-covered area rose sharply to 2,020 km² in one week. Ski centrum Dedinky leads with 48 cm. Data from 16 November.

item.title: Slovenia: snow line holds at 2,000 m as early flakes begin
item.description: Early November snow covers 1,130 km2 of Slovenia. The ground turns white above 2,000 m elevation; below that, most slopes stay brown. Data from 16 November 2026.

item.title: Spanish snow cover drops 540 km² in a week as rain eats away early season
item.description: Spain's snow-covered area fell to 310 km² on 16 November. Only 6 of 31 resorts have skiable snow, led by Aramón Cerler at 17 cm.

item.title: Abisko at 129 cm: Sweden's snowpack jumps 167,100 km²
item.description: Sweden's snow cover grew by 167,100 km² in one week. Abisko holds 129 cm as early-season water accumulates in high fells. Data from 16 November.

item.title: Up to 112 cm snow forecast for Switzerland in seven days
item.description: Snow model forecasts 112 cm in Switzerland by November 24, with 29 cm on November 17. Fresh water accumulates across the high Alps over the coming week.

item.title: Warmer day clears UK lowlands; snow retreats to 800 m
item.description: Warm weather on 16 November removed 1290 km2 of UK snow cover. The snow line is now at 800 metres; fresh snow arrives tomorrow.

item.title: Ukraine shed 3,440 km² of snow in a week: the high ridges stayed white
item.description: Ukraine's snow cover fell from 5,090 km² to 1,650 km² in a week. As of November 16, high terrain above 1,500 m held 89% cover. Up to 25 cm snow forecast in the next 7 days.

item.title: Why is Orelle suddenly deeper? 17 cm arrived in one week
item.description: Orelle reached 31 cm by 16 November, up 17 cm in one week. The Alps are forecast to get up to 103 cm more snow by 19 November.

item.title: Big White shows the starkest height gradient: 68 cm at the summit
item.description: At Big White on 15 November, the upper slopes hold 68 cm near the summit while the base remains bare; an extreme vertical gradient typical of early season.

item.title: Les Grands Montets: where will 79 cm of new snow fall?
item.description: 79 cm new snow forecast for Les Grands Montets from 16–18 November, mostly above 2000 m elevation, based on forecast from 15 November.

item.title: Pyrenees warming: pack waterproof gear as freezing level reaches 4080 m
item.description: Rain forecast as freezing level climbs to 4080 m; snow measured on 15 November is thin (under 20 cm) at all major Pyrenees resorts.

item.title: Courmayeur leads European Alps as snow reaches 142 percent of normal
item.description: Courmayeur leads forecast with 88 cm in 72 hours; snow depth is at 142 percent of normal for mid-November as of November 15 data.

item.title: Serre Chevalier in December: High Peaks and Valley Snow
item.description: Ski 157 km of mapped runs in Serre Chevalier where the top of the mountain has a 100 % chance of snow by mid-December.

item.title: December Alps and Pyrenees Ranked for Snow and Budget
item.description: Ten European ski resorts ranked for December value, led by Les 2 Alpes with 75 cm of mid-mountain snow.

item.title: Boí Taüll in December: higher base, lower day pass than Baqueira
item.description: Boí Taüll starts at 2039 m and beats Baqueira Beret on day-pass price, though early December snow still takes some patience.

item.title: Orcières Merlette: High-Altitude Skiing for a December Budget
item.description: Orcières Merlette offers a high base at 1826 m and a 6-day pass from 227 EUR, making it a reliable choice for a December ski trip.

item.title: Alpe d'Huez in December: fair prices and snow odds?
item.description: Is Alpe d'Huez worth it for December 2026? We check the snow odds, the starting price of 58.00 EUR, and compare it with Les 2 Alpes.
